units.source_text: ‘不要再说了？这又不是我要说的，本来就是你提起的啊。

en.t: Stop talking about it? This is not something I wanted to bring up; you were the one who brought it up in the first place.

units.source_text: 当然，你不想再提也可以，不过只停留在口头上是不行的，

en.t: Of course, if you do not want to mention it again, that is fine, but merely saying so is not enough.

units.source_text: 你必须从心里下决心，不再去想这件事。

en.t: You must resolve it in your heart and stop thinking about this matter.

units.source_text: 你究竟打算怎样坚持你一贯的信念呢？’

en.t: How exactly do you intend to hold to the convictions you have always professed?

units.source_text: 我这样说时，觉得他那高大的个头在我面前萎缩了，矮小了。

en.t: When I said this, I felt that his tall figure shrank and grew small before me.

units.source_text: 正如我说过的那样，他虽然性格非常倔强，却是个极其正直的人，

en.t: As I have said before, although he was extremely stubborn by nature, he was also an exceptionally honest man.

units.source_text: 所以当别人严厉地指出他这一矛盾时，他绝不会无所谓。

en.t: So when someone sharply pointed out this contradiction in him, he could never remain indifferent.

units.source_text: 我看见他这副样子，才终于放下心来。

en.t: Only after seeing him like this did I finally feel relieved.

units.source_text: 这时，他突然问道：‘下决心？’

en.t: At that moment, he suddenly asked, Resolve?

units.source_text: 我还没来得及回答，他又接着说：‘下决心，没什么不能下决心的。’

en.t: Before I had time to answer, he went on, Resolve; there is nothing that cannot be resolved.

units.source_text: 他的口气像是自言自语，又像是在说梦话。

en.t: His tone sounded like he was talking to himself, and also like he was speaking in a dream.

units.source_text: 我们没有再说话，向小石川的住处走去。

en.t: We said nothing more and walked toward our lodging in Koishikawa.

units.source_text: 那一天虽然风和日丽，但毕竟是冬天，公园里冷冷清清的。

en.t: Although the weather that day was calm and sunny, it was winter after all, and the park felt bleak and deserted.

units.source_text: 尤其当我回身看到那些被霜打过，变成茶褐色的杉树树梢齐刷刷地伸向昏暗的天空时，

en.t: Especially when I turned back and saw the frost-stricken cedar treetops, turned tea-brown, rising in a row toward the dim sky,

units.source_text: 只觉得一股寒气粘在后背上了似的。

en.t: I felt as if a chill had fastened itself to my back.

units.source_text: 我们急步穿过暮色中的本乡台，走下通向对面山坡的小石川洼地。

en.t: We hurried across Hongo Heights in the dusk and descended into the Koishikawa hollow that led toward the opposite slope.

units.source_text: 直到这时，我才渐渐感到外套里面的身子暖和了点。

en.t: Only then did I gradually begin to feel a little warmth in my body under my overcoat.
